result.summary: Category: stubbed-crypto-boundary (security). encrypt()/decrypt() in src/secrets/crypto.zig discard the master_key parameter (`_ = master_key;`) and copy plaintext verbatim into the ciphertext field via allocator.dupe, while populating envelope metadata claiming aes_256_gcm/aes_kw_256. Confirmed by direct source read. Severity confirmed BLOCKER (security defect, secrets stored as plaintext). files_to_change = [src/secrets/crypto.zig].
